name: @paigasus/sdk
_comment_exports: Source-only exports. Bundler-aware consumers only (Next/Vitest/tsc walk through TS via moduleResolution: bundler). Switch to ./dist/index.js when tsup wiring lands — must happen IN LOCKSTEP with flipping `private: false` for publishable packages.
_comment_entries: Five entry points, matching the design spec's § 6.1: `.`, `./iam`, `./chat`, `./errors`, `./errors/types`. The rule stays the same: no commit may leave the `exports` map naming a file that does not exist. An exports entry pointing at a stub is a public API promise this package would not keep — a consumer importing @paigasus/sdk/errors would get an empty module, which is worse than a resolution error. tests/server-guard.test.ts is driven off THIS map, so a new entry is covered the day it is added, with no edit to the test. `./errors/types` is the one entry deliberately left unguarded, pre-registered in that test's UNGUARDED_ENTRIES set.
description: Server-only Connect-ES clients for the Paigasus IAM gRPC services.
